issues.explanation: Julian was 35 in Ep5 and is 36 in Ep6, a one-year jump with no time passing between the episodes (the story is continuous, same night).
issues.suggested_fix: Set Julian's age to 35 in Ep6.

issues.explanation: Sienna is 30 in Ep5 and 31 in Ep6 in the same continuous scene sequence.
issues.suggested_fix: Set Sienna's age to 30 in Ep6.

issues.explanation: Marcus is 45 in Ep1, Ep2 and Ep4 but 48 in Ep6. Ep3 and Ep5 describe him only as 'in his 50s', which also conflicts.
issues.suggested_fix: Make Marcus 45 in Ep6 (and fix the 50s descriptions in Ep3 and Ep5).

issues.explanation: Celeste was 60 in Ep1 and 61 in Ep2, and is now 64 in Ep6. That is more aging than the story timeline allows.
issues.suggested_fix: Set Celeste's age to 61 or 62 in Ep6.

issues.explanation: Nora says Julian disappeared 'the night before our wedding' in 2018, but earlier episodes set the wedding date at June 14, 2018, or June 9, 2018, and Julian says he waited at the church, so he did not vanish the night before.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Nora's line to say he was gone on the wedding day, or reconcile it with Julian's claim.

issues.explanation: Sienna says Julian signed Leo over on March 3rd, 2019 'before he could even walk', but Leo is 6 now (about 2018–19 birth would make him ~5-6 and born before/around 2018), which fits poorly. This is likely just her claim and may be consistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Optionally clarify Leo's birth date relative to March 2019.
